format: new Blaze Freestanding Building (stand-alone restaurant, approx. 1,000 to 1,400 sq ft, typically with drive-through)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin the operation of a new free-standing Church's Restaurant ranges from $1,252,400 to $1,970,300 for the Blaze Freestanding Building ... Each of these estimates includes $45,500 - $55,000 that is paid to Cajun ... These estimates exclude real estate costs.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee ("Franchise Fee") is $20,000 for each Restaurant. You must pay the Franchise Fee, which is in addition to the Development Fee, when you sign the Franchise Agreement for each Restaurant.
fee.note: Plus a $10,000 Development Fee per Restaurant (a Development Agreement is required) and $15,500 Grand Opening Marketing Funds paid to Cajun. U.S. military veterans and first responders: Franchise Fee $10,000 for the first Restaurant. Diamond Incentive Program (DA for 3+ Restaurants signed by December 31, 2027): $0 Franchise Fee, $50,000 or $150,000 cash back per qualifying opening, royalty 2% to 5% and advertising 3% to 5% ramp over 4 years.

royalty.quote: Royalty2 5% of Gross Sales Within 5 business days after the end of each fiscal week.

adFund.quote: Advertising Fund Contribution 5% of Gross Sales (up to 1% of Gross Sales if a Regional Co-Op has been formed, plus contribution to Co-Op) and at least $25,000/year
adFund.note: 5% of Gross Sales with a minimum of $25,000 per year; if a Regional Co-Op is formed, up to 1% goes to the fund plus the co-op contribution.
